remarks: Welcome to your industrial-chic oasis in the heart of SONO! This stylish condo offers over 800 sqft of modern living space featuring 13ft ceilings, hardwood floors throughout, and an open floor plan. The kitchen is equipped with stainless steel appliances and granite countertops, complemented by a breakfast bar overlooking the living/dining area. A distinctive brick wall with a built-in entertainment center adds character, while barn doors offer privacy when desired. The spacious bedroom with brick wall offers an oversized walk-in closet that can double as an office space or dressing area. The updated bathroom completes this urban retreat. A brand new HVAC wall unit installed in 2026 adds comfort and value. Bonus!...Step outside to your own 25-foot private deck, perfect for entertaining or relaxing outdoors. Residents enjoy a recently remodeled lobby, secured entry, elevator access, and on-site laundry facilities. Ideally located in the heart of South Norwalk, just steps from the Norwalk Train Station, The SoNo Collection Mall, Norwalk Harbor, parks, restaurants, and local shops, this condo combines modern style with unbeatable convenience. With easy access to major highways and everything SONO has to offer right outside your door, commuting and city living couldn't be easier.
